title: Leche. talks about the internal battles we have with ourselves in “It Rushes Through”
htmlContent:
"It Rushes Through" is a song that connects with anyone who has ever felt held back by their thoughts. It speaks to that annoying voice in our heads that sometimes makes us doubt ourselves and our choices. The track invites listeners into a mesmerizing soundscape, blending dreamy sounds with captivating melodies reflecting self-doubt's struggle.

Leche.'s vocals are soft and firm, perfectly describing the emotions tied to the lyrics. Each line feels like a quiet sharing of feelings, revealing the challenge of wanting to break free while feeling stuck. The song combines gentle sounds with raw emotion. The way the music builds and fades mirrors the ups and downs of anxiety and hesitation that can catch us off guard.

https://open.spotify.com/album/6gG6HgGRp0ZmfN5kcmxrYd?si=kDIqNQmsRaOA1EG1FXkhOg

Leche.'s heartfelt delivery adds a touching quality, making "It Rushes Through" a relatable experience. With this song, Leche. shows their willingness to tackle the complicated feelings that come with being human. "It Rushes Through" is a reflective journey that helps us confront parts of ourselves we often try to hide. This track offers comfort for anyone feeling trapped in their own mind.
